build_point_sample_features: build a python module that uses point_sample to bilinearly interpolate features from a feature map at normalized point coordinates
generate_regular_grid_coords: generate a regular square grid of normalized point coordinates for a given number of regions and side size
sample_uncertain_point_coords: sample uncertain point coordinates from coarse logits using importance sampling and random sampling with configurable ratios
find_uncertain_points_on_grid: find the most uncertain points on a grid from an uncertainty map and return their indices and normalized coordinates
sample_point_labels_from_masks: sample point labels from ground truth bitmask annotations given image-level point coordinates for instance segmentation
